value.rationale: The claimed universal identity is structural, applies to every finite connected bipartite graph and finite symmetry group, and computes all rational Lefschetz and quotient Euler invariants from natural graph representations. It bridges a specific recent grid-like homotopy program with a graph-wide invariant that is not supplied by Betti ranks; even grids and arbitrary grid symmetries become strict corollaries.
